-- AutoDodge.lua — open source, no key, no loader
-- Target: Huss Valley (Roblox)
-- Executor: any with loadstring + task.spawn (Volt, Potassium, Delta, Wave, Xeno, Solara)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local CONFIG = {
    enabled = true,
    range = 28,
    closeRange = 10,       -- studs: extra-tight trigger, dodges even on cooldown tail
    dodgeDistance = 30,
    cooldown = 0.45,
    closeCooldown = 0.25,  -- shorter cooldown when threat is within closeRange
    dodgeKey = Enum.KeyCode.Q,
    useRemote = true,
}

local lastDodge = 0

local function getChar()
    return LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
end
local function getHRP()
    local c = getChar()
    return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function getHum()
    local c = getChar()
    return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function getThreats()
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return {}, 0 end
    local myPos = hrp.Position
    local out = {}
    local nearest = math.huge

    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
            local otherHrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local otherHum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if otherHrp and otherHum and otherHum.Health > 0 then
                local d = (otherHrp.Position - myPos).Magnitude
                if d < nearest then nearest = d end
                if d <= CONFIG.range then
                    table.insert(out, {pos = otherHrp.Position, dist = d, obj = p.Character})
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") and obj ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
            local hum = obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp2 = obj:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hum and hrp2 and hum.Health > 0 then
                local d = (hrp2.Position - myPos).Magnitude
                if d < nearest then nearest = d end
                if d <= CONFIG.range then
                    table.insert(out, {pos = hrp2.Position, dist = d, obj = obj})
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return out, nearest
end

local function escapeVector(threats)
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp or #threats == 0 then return nil end
    local sum = Vector3.zero
    for _, t in ipairs(threats) do
        sum = sum + t.pos
    end
    local centroid = sum / #threats
    local away = (hrp.Position - centroid)
    if away.Magnitude < 0.1 then
        away = Vector3.new(math.random(-1,1), 0, math.random(-1,1))
    end
    return away.Unit
end

local function fireRemoteDodge(dir)
    if not CONFIG.useRemote then return false end
    local remotes = {}
    for _, d in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            local n = d.Name:lower()
            if n:find("dodge") or n:find("dash") or n:find("tackle") or n:find("evade") then
                table.insert(remotes, d)
            end
        end
    end
    if #remotes == 0 then return false end
    for _, r in ipairs(remotes) do
        pcall(function()
            r:FireServer(dir)
            r:FireServer()
            r:FireServer(dir, true)
        end)
    end
    return true
end

local function velocityDodge(dir)
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return end
    local target = hrp.Position + dir * CONFIG.dodgeDistance
    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir * 90 + Vector3.new(0, 35, 0)
    task.delay(0.12, function()
        if hrp and hrp.Parent then
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(target + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
        end
    end)
end

local function doDodge(dir)
    if not fireRemoteDodge(dir) then
        velocityDodge(dir)
    end
    pcall(function()
        local vim = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
        vim:SendKeyEvent(true, CONFIG.dodgeKey, false, game)
        task.wait(0.05)
        vim:SendKeyEvent(false, CONFIG.dodgeKey, false, game)
    end)
end

-- ---------- GUI ----------
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "AutoDodgeGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
gui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Name = "Main"
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 56)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true              -- built-in drag
frame.Parent = gui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
corner.Parent = frame

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Thickness = 2
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
stroke.Parent = frame

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "AUTO DODGE"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 12
title.Parent = frame

local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Name = "Toggle"
button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 24)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 26)
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
button.BorderSizePixel = 0
button.Text = "ON"
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
button.TextSize = 13
button.AutoButtonColor = false
button.Parent = frame

local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
btnCorner.Parent = button

-- Rainbow: cycle hue on stroke + button background tint
local rainbowConn
local hue = 0
rainbowConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    hue = (hue + dt * 0.35) % 1
    local c = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
    stroke.Color = c
    if CONFIG.enabled then
        button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.85, 0.35)
    else
        button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
    end
end)

local function refreshButton()
    if CONFIG.enabled then
        button.Text = "ON"
    else
        button.Text = "OFF"
        button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
    end
end

button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    CONFIG.enabled = not CONFIG.enabled
    refreshButton()
end)

-- Drag with touch + mouse (Draggable covers mouse; add touch for mobile)
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
local function beginDrag(input)
    dragging = true
    dragStart = input.Position
    startPos = frame.Position
    input.Changed:Connect(function()
        if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
end
frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        beginDrag(input)
    end
end)
frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

refreshButton()

-- ---------- Loop ----------
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not CONFIG.enabled then return end
    local now = os.clock()

    local hum = getHum()
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

    local threats, nearest = getThreats()
    if #threats == 0 then return end

    local cd = (nearest <= CONFIG.closeRange) and CONFIG.closeCooldown or CONFIG.cooldown
    if now - lastDodge < cd then return end

    local dir = escapeVector(threats)
    if not dir then return end

    lastDodge = now
    doDodge(dir)
end)

-- RightShift also toggles
UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
        CONFIG.enabled = not CONFIG.enabled
        refreshButton()
    end
end)

scripts.script:
-- Mobile PvP Hub for Delta iOS (Aimbot + ESP)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

-- Configuration Variables
local _G = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
_G.AimbotEnabled = false
_G.EspEnabled = false
_G.TeamCheck = false
_G.MaxDistance = 500

-- Create Screen GUI (Parented to CoreGui to prevent detection/resetting)
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "DeltaPvPHub"
ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

-- Main Menu Frame
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 180)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.3, 0) -- Top-left safe zone for mobile players
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 35)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true -- Allows you to drag the menu anywhere on screen
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- UICorner for rounded layout
local MainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
MainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
MainCorner.Parent = MainFrame

-- Menu Title
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45)
Title.Text = "DELTA PVP MENU"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.TextSize = 14
Title.Parent = MainFrame

local TitleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
TitleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
TitleCorner.Parent = Title

-- Reusable Function to Build Mobile Toggle Buttons
local function CreateToggle(name, text, position, globalVar)
    local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Button.Name = name
    Button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 190, 0, 35)
    Button.Position = position
    Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
    Button.Text = text .. ": OFF"
    Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 75, 75)
    Button.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    Button.TextSize = 13
    Button.Parent = MainFrame

    local ButtonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    ButtonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    ButtonCorner.Parent = Button

    -- Click Functionality
    Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        _G[globalVar] = not _G[globalVar]
        if _G[globalVar] then
            Button.Text = text .. ": ON"
            Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(75, 255, 75)
            Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 65, 55)
        else
            Button.Text = text .. ": OFF"
            Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 75, 75)
            Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
        end
    end)
end

-- Generate Menu Toggles
CreateToggle("AimbotToggle", "🎯 AIMBOT", UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 50), "AimbotEnabled")
CreateToggle("EspToggle", "👁️ PLAYER ESP", UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 95), "EspEnabled")
CreateToggle("TeamToggle", "👥 TEAM CHECK", UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 140), "TeamCheck")

-- ==========================================
-- AIMBOT CORE LOGIC
-- ==========================================
local function getClosestPlayer()
    local closestPlayer = nil
    local shortestDistance = math.huge

    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            if player.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                if _G.TeamCheck and player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then continue end
                
                local targetPart = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                local screenPosition, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPart.Position)
                
                if onScreen then
                    local screenCenter = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
                    local targetPosVector = Vector2.new(screenPosition.X, screenPosition.Y)
                    local distanceToCenter = (targetPosVector - screenCenter).Magnitude
                    
                    local worldDistance = (targetPart.Position - LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude

                    if distanceToCenter < shortestDistance and worldDistance <= _G.MaxDistance then
                        closestPlayer = player
                        shortestDistance = distanceToCenter
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closestPlayer
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if _G.AimbotEnabled and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        local target = getClosestPlayer()
        if target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, target.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
        end
    end
end)

-- ==========================================
-- ESP CORE LOGIC (Highlights & Billboard Tags)
-- ==========================================
local function applyESP(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end

    local function setupVisuals(character)
        if not character then return end
        local head = character:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
        local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        if not head or not humanoid then return end

        -- 1. Chams/Highlight Wallhack
        local highlight = character:FindFirstChild("ESPHighlight") or Instance.new("Highlight")
        highlight.Name = "ESPHighlight"
        highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 100)
        highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
        highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
        highlight.Parent = character

        -- 2. Name & Health Billboard Tag
        local billboard = head:FindFirstChild("ESPTag") or Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        billboard.Name = "ESPTag"
        billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 30)
        billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
        billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        billboard.Parent = head

        local label = billboard:FindFirstChild("TextLabel") or Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        label.TextSize = 12
        label.Parent = billboard

        -- Loop to update tracking values dynamically
        local connection
        connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not character.Parent or not _G.EspEnabled then
                highlight.Enabled = false
                billboard.Enabled = false
                if not _G.EspEnabled then return end
            else
                highlight.Enabled = true
                billboard.Enabled = true
                label.Text = string.format("%s\n[HP: %d]", player.Name, math.floor(humanoid.Health))
            end
        end)

        humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            connection:Disconnect()
            highlight:Destroy()
            billboard:Destroy()
        end)
    end

    if player.Character then setupVisuals(player.Character) end
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupVisuals)
end

-- Initialize ESP for current and joining players
for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do applyESP(p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(applyESP)

scripts.features:
AlanUI es una librería de interfaces de vanguardia, altamente optimizada y diseñada para priorizar la compatibilidad, el rendimiento y la simplicidad. Funciona a la perfección en PC, Móvil y Consolas, adaptándose automáticamente a cualquier resolución de pantalla.

🌟 Características Principales:
• Diseño Visual Premium: Interfaz moderna con animaciones suaves (curvas de easing personalizadas), controles tipo "píldora", sombras, transiciones de color y feedback táctil al hacer clic.
• Sistema de Auto-Limpieza (Anti-Leaks): Limpia automáticamente conexiones, hilos y objetos Drawing al re-ejecutar el script, evitando caídas de FPS.
• Pestaña Preinstalada: Incluye una pestaña de ajustes por defecto con monitoreo de FPS, uso de memoria, salud de la interfaz, diagnóstico del ejecutor, escalado de UI y cambio de temas en vivo.
• Persistencia Nativa: Sistema de guardado automático (Auto-Save) y gestión de perfiles (crear, cargar, exportar e importar configuraciones).
• Historial de Cambios: Soporte nativo para Deshacer (Undo) y Rehacer (Redo) cambios en los controles.
• Buscador Global: Barra de búsqueda integrada que filtra dinámicamente todos los controles de la interfaz.

🎛️ Controles Incluidos:
• Botones (con soporte Async y spinner de carga).
• Toggles, Casillas y RadioGroups.
• Sliders (con soporte de pasos y sufijos) y RangeSliders (doble manija Min/Max).
• NumberSteppers (botones +/- con campo editable).
• Inputs de texto (normal, multilínea, validación de números y patrones Regex).
• Dropdowns simples y múltiples (con buscador interno y soporte para iconos/descripciones).
• ColorPickers (Estilo RGB clásico o estilo 2D moderno con hexadecimal y paleta de colores).
• Keybinds (Soporte para modificadores como Ctrl/Shift/Alt, modo Hold y modo Toggle).
• TagInputs (creación de "chips" dinámicos).
• Elementos visuales: Labels (con auto-actualización), Barras de Progreso, Imágenes, Divisores y Tags animados en el encabezado (incluye estilo Arcoíris).

🛠️ Para Desarrolladores:
• API intuitiva (Set, Get, ObtenerFlag, Try).
• Sistema de generación de UI a través de esquemas (ConstruirDesdeSchema).
• Manejo de errores integrado con notificaciones visuales sin romper el script.
• Compatibilidad total con ejecutores que carecen de funciones nativas (polyfills de task.* y table.clone).

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        local delta = input.Position - mousePos
        ToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(
            framePos.X.Scale, framePos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            framePos.Y.Scale, framePos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

-- ==========================================
-- 2. VERIFICAÇÕES
-- ==========================================
local function alvoVivo(char)
    if not char or not char.Parent then return false end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
    return true
end

-- ==========================================
-- 3. PROCURAR NOVO ALVO (Players + NPCs)
-- ==========================================
local function encontrarNovoAlvo()
    local melhor, menorDist = nil, math.huge
    local centro = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    local origem = Camera.CFrame.Position

    local lista = {}

    for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
            table.insert(lista, plr.Character)
        end
    end

    for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") and obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj) and obj ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
                table.insert(lista, obj)
            end
        end
    end

    for _, char in pairs(lista) do
        if char ~= LocalPlayer.Character and alvoVivo(char) then
            local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if head then
                local dist = (origem - head.Position).Magnitude
                if dist <= MAX_DISTANCE then
                    local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                    if onScreen then
                        local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - centro).Magnitude
                        if d <= FOV and d < menorDist then
                            menorDist = d
                            melhor = char
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return melhor
end

-- ==========================================
-- 4. LOOP ANTI-VOID (ROTAÇÃO SEGURA)
-- ==========================================
local function tick()
    if not alvoVivo(target) then
        target = encontrarNovoAlvo()
    end

    if target then
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not alvoVivo(myChar) then return end
        
        local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local head = target:FindFirstChild("Head") or target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if myRoot and head then
            -- Calcula a direção mantendo a altura Y idêntica para não inclinar o personagem
            local targetPos = head.Position
            local rootPos = myRoot.Position
            local dir = Vector3.new(targetPos.X - rootPos.X, 0, targetPos.Z - rootPos.Z)

            -- Evita cálculos zerados/inválidos quando estiver encostado no alvo ou sofrendo knockback
            if dir.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                local newCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(rootPos, rootPos + dir)
                -- Aplica apenas a rotação mantendo a física da posição intacta (evita cair no void ao tomar dano/ataques)
                myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(rootPos) * (newCFrame - newCFrame.Position)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- 5. ATIVAR / DESATIVAR
-- ==========================================
local function ativarMira()
    print("[MIRA] Ativada!")
    RunService:BindToRenderStep(renderName, Enum.RenderPriority.Character.Value + 1, tick)
end

local function desativarMira()
    print("[MIRA] Desativada.")
    pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(renderName) end)
    target = nil
end

ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isActive = not isActive
    if isActive then
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
        ToggleButton.Text = "Mira: ATIVADA"
        ativarMira()
    else
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)
        ToggleButton.Text = "Mira: DESATIVADA"
        desativarMira()
    end
end)

local Children=150000
local NestedPerChild=0
local FieldsPerChild=0
local FireBurst=1
local FrameDelay=0.125
local FieldSize=0
local RebuildEach=false
local state={running=false,thread=nil,remote=nil,cache=nil,pad="",}
local function resolve()
local rrs=game:FindFirstChild("RobloxReplicatedStorage")
if not rrs then return nil end
local r=rrs:FindFirstChild("SetPlayerBlockList")
if r and(r:IsA("RemoteEvent")or r:IsA("UnreliableRemoteEvent"))then
return r
end
return nil
end
state.remote=resolve()
pcall(function()
game:GetService("NetworkClient"):SetOutgoingKBPSLimit(math.huge)
end)
state.pad=FieldSize>0 and string.rep("P",FieldSize)or""
local function build()
local root=table.create(Children)
for i=1,Children do
local entry={id=i,v=i*2}
for k=1,FieldsPerChild do
entry["k"..k]=(FieldSize>0)and state.pad or(i+k)
end
for j=1,NestedPerChild do
entry["n"..j]={a=i,b=j}
end
root[i]=entry
end
return root
end
local function fire()
if not state.remote then
state.remote=resolve()
if not state.remote then return end
end
local payload
if RebuildEach or not state.cache then
payload=build()
if not RebuildEach then state.cache=payload end
else
payload=state.cache
end
for _=1,FireBurst do
state.remote:FireServer(payload)
end
end
local function start()
if state.running then return end
state.running=true
state.cache=nil
state.thread=task.spawn(function()
while state.running do
pcall(fire)
if FrameDelay>0 then
task.wait(FrameDelay)
else
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
end
end)
end

state.running=false
if state.thread then pcall(task.cancel,state.thread)end
state.thread=nil
state.cache=nil
end
return{start=start,stop=stop,toggle=function()if state.running then stop()else start()end end,isRunning=function()return state.running end,}]==]

	setHair(false)
	ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)

-- Přetahování okna
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
MainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true dragStart = input.Position startPos = MainFrame.Position
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = false
	end
end)

scripts.title: auto start waves for afk
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
local Event = RS:WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("DefenseStartWaves")

-- Anti AFK
plr.Idled:Connect(function()
	VirtualUser:CaptureController()
	VirtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
end)

pcall(function()
	StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
		Title = "AntiAFK Berhasil!",
		Text = "Dibuat oleh Novarosenz",
		Button1 = "Ashiap",
		Duration = 5
	})
end)

-- UI Start Wave
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
gui.Name = "WaveStartUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local frame = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 90)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -90, 0.3, 0)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 35)
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true
Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "Start Wave"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 14

local box = Instance.new("TextBox", frame)
box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 28)
box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 28)
box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 55)
box.Text = "1"
box.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
box.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
box.TextSize = 16
box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
Instance.new("UICorner", box).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 26)
btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 60)
btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 140, 90)
btn.Text = "START"
btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
btn.TextSize = 14
Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local function setBtn(text, color)
	btn.Text = text
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(0, 140, 90)
end

local function getWave()
	local n = tonumber(box.Text)
	return n and math.max(1, math.floor(n)) or 1
end

local function fireWave()
	local wave = getWave()
	pcall(function()
		Event:FireServer({
			Mode = "Normal",
			StartWave = wave
		})
	end)
	print("Start wave:", wave)
end

local function getClaim()
	local main = plr.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("Main")
	local endResult = main and main:FindFirstChild("EndResult")
	local action = endResult and endResult:FindFirstChild("Action")
	return action and action:FindFirstChild("Claim")
end

local function clickClaim()
	local claim = getClaim()
	if not claim then return false end
	pcall(function()
		claim:Activate()
	end)
	pcall(function()
		if firesignal then
			firesignal(claim.MouseButton1Click)
			firesignal(claim.Activated)
		end
	end)
	print("Claim ditekan")
	return true
end

local busy = false
local cancel = false
local lastId = tonumber(plr:GetAttribute("DefenseResultId")) or 0

local function onResultIdUp()
	if busy then return end
	busy = true
	cancel = false
	task.spawn(function()
		setBtn("WAITING...", Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 60))
		task.wait(2)
		if cancel then setBtn("CANCELED", Color3.fromRGB(160, 50, 50)) busy = false return end

		setBtn("CLAIMING...", Color3.fromRGB(180, 120, 40))
		clickClaim()
		task.wait(2)
		if cancel then setBtn("CANCELED", Color3.fromRGB(160, 50, 50)) busy = false return end

		setBtn("STARTING...", Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 180))
		fireWave()
		task.wait(0.8)
		if cancel then setBtn("CANCELED", Color3.fromRGB(160, 50, 50)) busy = false return end

		setBtn("START", Color3.fromRGB(0, 140, 90))
		busy = false
	end)
end

btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if busy then
		-- cancel proses yang sedang jalan
		cancel = true
		setBtn("CANCELED", Color3.fromRGB(160, 50, 50))
		task.delay(1, function()
			if not busy then
				setBtn("START", Color3.fromRGB(0, 140, 90))
			end
		end)
		return
	end

	-- start manual
	busy = true
	cancel = false
	setBtn("STARTING...", Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 180))
	fireWave()
	task.wait(0.8)
	if not cancel then
		setBtn("START", Color3.fromRGB(0, 140, 90))
	else
		setBtn("CANCELED", Color3.fromRGB(160, 50, 50))
	end
	busy = false
end)

plr:GetAttributeChangedSignal("DefenseResultId"):Connect(function()
	local now = tonumber(plr:GetAttribute("DefenseResultId")) or 0
	if now == lastId + 1 and not cancel then
		onResultIdUp()
	end
	lastId = now
end)
